scope: Allocation diagnostic and injected original PLY-3 replay; no production code change.

allocationProbe.runtime: Node.js 22.22.0, separate guarded processes, explicit collection before and after each allocation
allocationProbe.method: Convert a Float64Array of fractional values to an ordinary numeric array. The indexed method allocates an empty array at final length and assigns each value; the seeded method starts with a fractional value, sets the final length and assigns each value. Both check the first and last values.
allocationProbe.limitations: A synthetic Node/V8 measurement with collection is not a browser heap profile or proof of production memory savings.

browserReplay.method: The isolated server removed the decoder's numeric reuse callback and changed one ordinary-array allocation in the served minified bundle to use a fractional seed. Both replacements were counted in served responses. The integration worktree and production build were not modified.
browserReplay.result: Split, Extract, export and download completed. The GUI selected the project and confirmed replacement, but the MCP bridge disconnected before reopened geometry and history could be checked.

interpretation: The synthetic allocation improvement did not produce a passing full-size independent restore. Differences between individual runs cannot establish causality or a resource guarantee. The ownership and M2 acceptance gates remain open.
